notes.title: Möbler hotfix patch 1.0.1 is live!
notes.notes:
v1.0.1 is now live for everyone to play!

We heard some of your issues and have rolled out a hotfix for you to make the play experience more fun and streamlined!

This hotfix includes the following changes:
- Fixed in-game audio not working.
- Removed survey link from the game over screen.
- Applied the correct application icon.

Thank you for your feedback.
Have fun playing and good luck reaching the stars,
The Möbler development team

notes.title: Möbler has been officially released!
notes.notes:
Welcome!

After a lot of hard work we, the Möbler development team, a student game development team at Breda University are very proud to announce that Möbler can now be downloaded and played on Steam.
We have put all of our best efforts into making this game as good as possible and present this with proud and joy.
Let us know what you think about Möbler!

Have fun playing,
The Möbler Development Team
